definitions: A Spanish phrase meaning "Take the Game."
The title of a song by the artist El Alfa El Jefe.
A common phrase used in sports or competitive contexts in Spanish-speaking cultures.
examples: The crowd chanted "Toma el Juego!" as the team scored.
Have you heard El Alfa's new track, "Toma el Juego"?
The coach's motto was simple: Toma el Juego.
